detail: 태그를 제거한 결과가 원문과 다름 (모델이 텍스트를 고쳐 씀)
text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.
